reason: Changes core shape caching logic (single-slot fast path replacing dictionary lookup keyed by Type) used throughout the display pipeline, so any subtle bug in the new UseMainCacheContext/type-change logic could silently break shape caching or cause wrong cache reuse across many themes/modules relying on GetCacheContext/Cache().
